name: Coalville Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Greenhill Community Centre. Open Mon and Thu for distribution. Referral required.

name: North West Leicestershire Council Allotments
short_description: NW Leicestershire Council allotment sites in Coalville area
image: and Whitwick. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists available. Includes water access and storage sheds.

name: Coalville Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Greenhill Park. Grows vegetables and soft fruits with harvest shared among volunteers. Focus on sustainable growing methods.
